name: Nicasia Vineyards
notes: Nicasia Vineyards produces this Red Blend with grapes from the renowned Valle de Uco region, known for its high-altitude vineyards and exceptional terroir. The wine combines Malbec with Cabernet Sauvignon and Petit Verdot, bringing together rich, ripe fruit flavors with structured tannins. Expect notes of dark berries, plum, and a hint of spice. The wine’s complexity is complemented by the vibrant acidity characteristic of the region.

name: Cocodrilo Corte
notes: Cocodrilo Corte is produced by Viña Cobos in Mendoza, Argentina. This red blend combines Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec, Merlot, and Petit Verdot grapes. It is known for its deep red color and complex profile featuring black fruit, spices, and hints of vanilla. The wine displays balanced acidity and firm tannins, making it suitable for pairing with grilled meats and hearty dishes. Reviews highlight its potential for aging and integration over several years.

name: Pêra-Grave
notes: Vinho Regional Alentejano produced by Pêra-Grave Sociedade Agrícola Unipessoal, Lda. Located at Quinta de S. José de Peramanca, 7000 Portugal. For tasting notes and flavor profiles, additional research is required.

name: Quinta de Alcube Grande Reserva
notes: Quinta de Alcube Grande Reserva is a limited edition red wine with only 1600 bottles produced. It is crafted in the Setúbal region of Portugal. This wine is known for its complex flavors and rich aroma, with notes of dark berries, spices, and a hint of oak. Perfect for pairing with red meats and mature cheeses.

name: Guarda Rios Gold Edition
notes: Guarda Rios Gold Edition is a red blend crafted from Syrah, Aragonez, and Alicante Bouschet grapes. The wine aims to present a modern, structured, and exuberant profile. It is produced in the Alentejo region of Portugal, which is known for its rich and bold wines. The label indicates the wine has received a Gold Medal from the Concours Mondial De Bruxelles. The selection of grapes is made from the best bunches, focusing on quality and expressive flavor. Expect notes of red and dark fruits, a well-integrated structure, and a polished finish.

name: Quinta da Mimosa
notes: Quinta da Mimosa is a red wine produced by Casa Ermelinda Freitas, located in Palmela, Portugal. The wine is made predominantly from Castelão grapes, known for producing wines with rich berry flavors, soft tannins, and good aging potential. The 2023 vintage offers an intense aroma of red fruits and spice, showcasing a full-bodied profile with balanced acidity and a lingering finish. Ideal pairing with red meats and mature cheeses.

name: Casa Ermelinda Freitas
notes: The Casa Ermelinda Freitas Syrah Reserva 2022 is a red wine made in the Península de Setúbal region of Portugal. This wine showcases flavors of ripe dark fruits, spices, and a hint of vanilla, typical of quality Syrah. The wine is aged to enhance the complexity and depth of flavors, offering a full-bodied experience.

name: Amarone della Valpolicella Zenato
notes: Produced by Zenato, Amarone della Valpolicella Classico is a rich and full-bodied red wine. It showcases notes of cherry, plum, and chocolate with hints of spice and tobacco. This wine is known for its complex flavor profile and long aging potential. It is a DOCG wine, indicating it meets the highest quality standards in Italy.

name: Porta 6
notes: Porta 6 is a popular red wine from Lisbon, Portugal, known for its vibrant and fruity profile. It is a blend of Aragonez, Castelão, and Touriga Nacional grapes. The wine features flavors of ripe red berries, plums, and has a smooth texture with a slight spice on the finish. It pairs well with grilled meats and Mediterranean dishes. The label artwork represents Lisbon's iconic tram and urban scenery, adding a cultural touch to the wine experience.

name: Mucho Más
notes: Produced by Félix Solís. Mucho Más is a vibrant red wine with notes of ripe fruit, subtle spice, and a smooth, lingering finish. It is a versatile wine, perfect for pairing with a variety of dishes.

name: Caballo Loco Grand Cru Limarí
notes: Caballo Loco Grand Cru Limarí is a premium wine from the Limarí Valley in Chile, known for its complex and elegant flavor profile. The wine predominantly features Syrah grapes which contribute to its bold character with rich notes of dark fruits, spices, and a hint of minerality. Produced by Valdivieso, this wine exhibits a deep color and possesses a well-balanced acidity with smooth tannins. It is a representation of the unique terroir of Limarí, often praised for its quality and aging potential.

name: Maleza Terroir Selection
notes: Maleza Malbec Terroir Selection is an organic red wine from Mendoza, Argentina. It showcases vibrant floral and tropical fruit characteristics on the label. Certified organic by Argencert, this wine represents the rich terroir and winemaking traditions of Mendoza.

name: Saint Felicien
notes: Saint Felicien Malbec is produced by Catena Zapata in Mendoza, Argentina. It is a full-bodied red wine with flavors of dark fruit such as plum and blackberry, complemented by notes of spice and earthy undertones. The wine is known for its well-structured tannins and balanced acidity. It pairs well with grilled meats and robust dishes. Aging potential is excellent, making it a suitable option for cellaring. The label depicts rustic imagery that reflects the traditional wine-making heritage of the region.

name: Col d'Orcia Rosso di Montalcino
notes: Col d'Orcia Rosso di Montalcino is a vibrant and fruity red wine made primarily from Sangiovese grapes grown in the Montalcino region of Italy. This wine typically showcases aromas of red berries, cherries, and floral notes with hints of spice and earthiness. It is known for its balance of acidity and tannins, making it a versatile wine suitable for pairing with a range of dishes such as pasta, grilled meats, and cheeses. Col d'Orcia is a renowned wine producer, committed to sustainable and organic farming practices.

name: Colección Colores Veramonte
notes: Veramonte's Colección Colores Reserva Carmenere from the Valle de Colchagua in Chile is a red wine with a rich and deep color. It features flavors of dark fruits such as blackberry and plum, complemented by notes of spice and mocha. The wine has a smooth texture with well-integrated tannins and a balanced finish. Known for its expressive character, this Carmenere pairs well with grilled meats and robust dishes. The 2023 vintage is part of Veramonte's commitment to sustainable viticulture and winemaking.

name: 62 Anniversario Riserva
notes: San Marzano 62 Anniversario Riserva is a celebrated wine from Primitivo di Manduria DOC. Known for its rich, full-bodied profile, it offers flavors of ripe dark berries, plums, and hints of chocolate and vanilla. Aging in oak barrels adds complexity and smooth tannins. Ideal for pairing with hearty dishes and cheeses. The vineyard is situated in Puglia, Southern Italy, benefiting from the region's warm climate.

name: Gran Enemigo Agrelo
notes: Gran Enemigo is a single vineyard wine from Agrelo, Mendoza. It is crafted from Cabernet Franc. This wine often displays notes of red fruits, spices, and herbs with a refined tannin structure. The 2021 vintage is known for its balance and complexity, respecting the terroir of Mendoza and showcasing the high altitude vineyard characteristics.

name: Astrale Rosso D’Italia
notes: Astrale Rosso d'Italia is marked as a Special Edition. It is an Italian red wine. Contains a constellation-themed label design. Tasting notes and detailed information not available from visible label alone. Further information can potentially be found from the producer or major wine retailers.

name: Casal Garcia Fruitzy Passion Fruit
notes: Casal Garcia Fruitzy Passion Fruit is a refreshing, low-alcohol wine with natural flavors of passion fruit. It is meant to be served chilled. Casal Garcia, established in 1939, is known for producing light, vibrant wines. The wine's flavor is characterized by its tropical fruit notes, making it ideal for warm weather get-togethers or as an aperitif. Best enjoyed in a relaxed setting.

name: Gran Enemigo El Cepillo
notes: El Cepillo Single Vineyard is known for producing wines with high concentration and complexity. The wine displays flavors of dark fruits, spices, and has robust tannins with a long finish. Crafted by acclaimed winemaker Alejandro Vigil, it's often praised for its balance and elegance.

name: Mil Demonios
notes: Produced by Sin Reglas Wines. The label features a distinct illustration and emphasizes a unique approach to winemaking with the tagline 'Created and Drunk by owners.'

name: Andes Plateau Cota 500
notes: Andes Plateau Cota 500 is a red wine produced in the Cachapoal Valley, Chile. Known for its vibrant fruit flavors, this Cabernet Sauvignon typically exhibits notes of blackcurrant, plum, and spice, with a well-structured body and balanced tannins. The wine is crafted at an altitude of 500 meters, which contributes to its unique profile.

name: D.V. Catena Adrianna Vineyard
notes: D.V. Catena Vineyard Designated Malbec from Adrianna Vineyard in the Tupungato region of Mendoza is known for its rich flavors and deep color. It features aromas of dark fruits like blackberry and plum, with notes of spice, chocolate, and a touch of violet. This wine is produced by Catena Zapata, which is renowned for its high-quality Malbecs. The wine exhibits a full-bodied structure with lush tannins and a long, elegant finish.

name: El Maiten Superior
notes: El Maiten Cabernet Sauvignon from the Valle Central in Chile is known for its rich and full-bodied profile. The wine features aromas of dark berries, plums, and subtle hints of oak. On the palate, it showcases flavors of blackberry and cherry with integrated tannins. This wine pairs well with grilled meats and strong cheeses. The Valle Central region is renowned for producing high-quality wines due to its ideal climate and soil conditions.

name: Colección Colores Veramonte
notes: This wine is a Reserva Pinot Noir from the Valle de Casablanca in Chile. It has a wine label depicting artistic circles, suggesting a colorful style and presentation. Veramonte is known for its commitment to sustainable practices and producing wines with a distinct expression of their regions. Tasting notes typically include red fruit flavors with earthy undertones and a smooth, elegant finish. The alcohol content is noted as 14%. The Valle de Casablanca is well-regarded for its cool-climate vineyards, ideal for Pinot Noir.

name: EA Tinto
notes: EA Tinto is a red wine produced by Cartuxa in the Alentejo region of Portugal. It is known for its rich fruity profiles with notes of berries and spices. The wine has a smooth texture typical of Portuguese reds from this region. Cartuxa is well-regarded for producing quality wines with traditional methods. The blend often includes native Portuguese grape varietals, contributing to its unique character.

name: Dona Ermelinda Grande Reserva
notes: Dona Ermelinda Grande Reserva is produced by Casa Ermelinda Freitas. It is known for its rich and robust character, featuring a blend of Portuguese varietals such as Touriga Nacional and Touriga Franca along with Syrah, Trincadeira, and Cabernet Sauvignon. The wine is aged to enhance its complexity and depth, offering a full-bodied profile with notes of dark fruit, spices, and a hint of oak. It is a distinguished member of the Vinho Regional classification and reflects the distinctive terroir of the Peninsula de Setúbal.

name: Renacer
notes: Renacer Malbec 2019 is a rich and full-bodied red wine from Mendoza, Argentina. It features flavors of ripe black fruits, plum, and subtle vanilla, with a hint of spice. The wine is well-balanced with smooth tannins and a lingering finish. Produced by Bodega Renacer, known for blending traditional methods with modern techniques to create premium wines that reflect the terroir of the Andes.

name: Judas
notes: Bodega Sottano's Judas Malbec is known for its intense and complex flavor profile. From the renowned Mendoza region, it typically features dark fruit flavors, such as blackberry and plum, along with notes of chocolate, vanilla, and spice. The wine is often aged in French oak, adding to its depth and character. It pairs well with grilled meats and hearty dishes.

name: Palácio da Bacalhôa
notes: Palácio da Bacalhôa is a red wine produced by Bacalhôa Vinhos de Portugal, located in the region of Península de Setúbal. Known for its historical and architectural heritage, the region contributes to the wine's rich and complex flavor profile. The wine is noted for its deep color, intense aroma of red fruits, and hints of spice and oak. Bacalhôa is recognized for blending traditional and modern winemaking techniques, offering a balanced palate with smooth tannins and a long finish. The wine is widely praised for its ability to age gracefully.

name: Angelica Zapata Malbec Alta
notes: Produced by Bodega Catena Zapata, Angelica Zapata Malbec Alta is a premium wine known for its rich and intense flavor profile. It typically exhibits notes of dark fruits such as blackberry and plum, with hints of spice and floral elements. The wine is well-structured with a long finish, and it is often praised for its balance and depth. Aged in French oak, it offers a complex nose and smooth tannins, making it a popular choice among Malbec enthusiasts.

name: Chandon Passion On Ice
notes: Chandon Passion On Ice is a Rosé Demi-Sec, designed to be served over ice, offering a refreshing and fruity profile. It is crafted by Chandon Argentina, known for blending traditional sparkling wine techniques with innovative tropical influences. The wine is likely to exhibit floral and fruit-forward notes, ideal for casual or celebratory occasions.

name: Gran Enemigo Gualtallary
notes: Gran Enemigo comes from Gualtallary, a renowned wine region in Mendoza, Argentina. This single vineyard wine is crafted primarily from Cabernet Franc. It typically exhibits notes of dark fruits, such as blackcurrant and plum, with hints of spice and earthy undertones. The 2020 vintage is marked by its intensity and structure, promising great aging potential. Crafted by esteemed winemaker Alejandro Vigil, it reflects the terroir of Mendoza with depth and complexity.

name: O Leão Vik
notes: O Leão is a red blend from the Cachapoal Valley in Chile. The label features a prominent lion design. This wine is likely to have robust and complex flavors characteristic of red blends from this region. Additional information regarding specific grape varietals or vintage year is not visible on the label.

name: Bramare
notes: Bramare Malbec from Viña Cobos is a wine from Mendoza, Argentina, specifically the Valle de Uco region. Known for its rich and structured profile, this wine exhibits notes of blackberry, plum, and spice. The wine is produced by Viña Cobos and showcases the region's terroir. It is often praised for its balance and elegance, with a full-bodied texture and smooth tannins.

name: El Enemigo Malbec
notes: El Enemigo Malbec is produced in Mendoza, Argentina, known for its high-altitude vineyards. The wine typically exhibits flavors of dark fruit, plum, and blackberry with hints of cocoa and violet. It is crafted by the renowned winemaker Alejandro Vigil. The wine often has a full-bodied profile with balanced acidity and a smooth finish. It pairs well with grilled meats and hearty dishes.

name: Alfacinha
notes: Alfacinha is a Vinho Regional from Lisboa, Portugal. The label describes 'Alfacinha' as a popular expression used in Lisbon, and the wine is intended to honor this historic city and its people. Vinho Tinto indicates it is a red wine. The bottle has a 2021 Berliner Wein Trophy gold award sticker.

name: Catena Zapata Birth of Cabernet
notes: The Catena Zapata Birth of Cabernet is crafted by the renowned Catena family in the Mendoza region of Argentina. Known for their innovative winemaking and high-altitude vineyards, Catena Zapata produces wines with depth and complexity. This Cabernet Sauvignon offers a rich palate with notes of blackcurrant, plum, and spices. The wine is well-structured with a long finish, showcasing the potential of Argentine Cabernet Sauvignon.

name: Loma Negra Gran Reserva Syrah
notes: Loma Negra Gran Reserva Syrah from the D.O. Valle de Colchagua is a Chilean red wine characterized by rich and robust flavors. The region is well-known for producing vibrant red wines, with Syrah often showcasing dark fruit notes like blackberry and plum, complemented by spice and pepper. The wine is appreciated for its balance and depth, with a smooth finish. The label notes a 90-point rating by Alistair Cooper MW.

name: Perez Cruz Gran Reserva
notes: Perez Cruz Gran Reserva is a highly regarded wine from the Maipo Andes region of Chile. This Cabernet Sauvignon is known for its rich flavors of blackcurrant, cherry, and hints of chocolate. The wine typically features a full body with smooth tannins and a long, elegant finish. It is estate bottled by Perez Cruz Family Vineyards, emphasizing quality and tradition. The wine pairs well with red meats and aged cheeses.

name: D.V. Catena Cabernet-Malbec
notes: The D.V. Catena Cabernet Malbec from Viñedo La Pirámide and Viñedo Angélica offers a rich blend that represents the tradition and effort of the Catena Zapata family. Known for its deep, robust flavors, this wine typically exhibits notes of dark berries, plum, and hints of spice, with a balanced acidity and a smooth finish. The vineyards are located in Mendoza, which provides ideal conditions for growing bold red varietals like Malbec and Cabernet Sauvignon.

name: Sapo de Otro Pozo Blend de Tintas
notes: Blend De Tintas 2023. Produced in Mendoza, Argentina. Offers a complex aroma with hints of dark berries, spices, and floral notes. The palate is rich and balanced with smooth tannins and a lingering finish.

name: Catena Zapata Malbec Argentino
notes: Catena Zapata is a renowned wine producer in Mendoza, Argentina, known for its high-quality Malbec. The Malbec Argentino is celebrated for its deep flavor profile, often displaying notes of ripe black fruit, spices, and earthy undertones. It is made from 100% Malbec grapes sourced from top vineyard sites. This wine is known for its balance of fruit, tannins, and acidity, making it suitable for aging. The intricate label artwork represents the history and cultural contributions of immigrants in Argentina.

name: Casa Perini Charmat Brut
notes: Casa Perini Charmat Brut is a sparkling wine from the Serra Gaúcha region of Brazil. It is produced by Casa Perini, a notable winery established in 1929. This espumante natural branco brut is made using the Charmat method, a technique commonly used for producing sparkling wines. The wine is known for its fresh and fruity flavor profile, with notes of green apple and citrus. It has a crisp acidity and is often enjoyed as an aperitif or paired with light dishes.

name: Sessantanni Primitivo di Manduria
notes: Sessantanni Primitivo di Manduria is produced by San Marzano. It is known for its rich and full-bodied flavor profile with notes of ripe black fruit, chocolate, and spices. The wine is aged in oak, providing a velvety texture and a long-lasting finish. It carries the Denominazione di Origine Protetta (DOP) classification.

name: EPU Almaviva
notes: EPU is the second wine of Almaviva, a collaboration between Baron Philippe de Rothschild and the Chilean winery Concha y Toro. It is mainly made from Cabernet Sauvignon grapes. This wine is known for its rich and complex profile, featuring flavors of dark fruits, blackcurrant, plum, and subtle notes of spices and tobacco. The wine is aged in French oak barrels, contributing to its elegant tannins and long finish. EPU, meaning 'two' in Mapudungun, reflects the partnership and synergy in its creation.

name: Barrabas by Judas
notes: Barrabas by Judas is a bold and expressive Cabernet Franc from the Mendoza region in Argentina. It typically showcases flavors of dark berries, spice, and earthy undertones. The wine is crafted to emphasize the unique terroir of Mendoza, offering a rich and smooth texture with well-integrated tannins. It pairs well with grilled meats and robust dishes. The label design reflects its distinctive style.

name: Levántalos
notes: Levántalos is a blend of 50% Tempranillo and 50% Monastrell. It is produced in the Levante region of Spain, known for robust red wines. The wine exhibits notes of red berries, plum, and a hint of spice, attributed to the Monastrell varietal. The Tempranillo contributes to its smooth tannins and moderate acidity. This wine pairs well with grilled meats and hard cheeses. The label features a playful design, highlighting the wine's casual and approachable style.

name: Pai Horácio
notes: Pai Horácio Vinho Tinto 2021 is a Grande Reserva red wine from the Douro region in Portugal. This well-crafted wine embodies the rich and full-bodied characteristics typical of the Douro wines. It likely features notes of dark fruits, spices, and a hint of earthy undertones, making it suitable for pairing with hearty dishes or enjoying on its own. The wine is produced with the intention of representing traditional wine-making techniques and offers a glimpse into the quality and character of the Douro region.

name: Triesi
notes: Triesi Nero d'Avola from Sicilia DOC is a red wine known for its rich, full-bodied profile. It typically exhibits flavors of dark fruit, such as black cherry and plum, combined with spicy notes from oak aging. This wine is a quintessential example of Sicily's most important red grape variety, Nero d'Avola, cherished for its bold flavors and smooth, velvety tannins. The label features an artistic design that symbolizes the rich tradition and vibrant culture of Sicily.

name: Chandon Réserve Brut
notes: Chandon Réserve Brut is made by Domaine Chandon in Brazil. It is known for its fresh and vibrant character with a crisp acidity. The wine often features notes of green apple, citrus, and a hint of toastiness, reflective of traditional sparkling wine production.

name: Let It Bee
notes: Let It Bee is a blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Tempranillo, and Merlot. The wine label features a floral design with a bee, suggesting a focus on natural elements. Further details regarding the producer, region, and specific flavor profiles are not visible on the label and could not be verified online.

name: Paine Cordillera
notes: Paine Cordillera is a Chilean Sauvignon Blanc with a 12.5% alcohol content. It features a detailed label design showcasing a mountain landscape and a native animal, reflecting the wine's origin in the Chilean terrain. The Sauvignon Blanc grape is known for its crisp acidity and vibrant flavors, often comprising citrus, green fruit, and herbaceous notes. Ideal for pairing with seafood and light salads.

name: Cabriz
notes: Cabriz is a renowned producer in the Dão region of Portugal, known for its balanced and elegant wines. This wine is crafted from indigenous grape varieties including Touriga Nacional, Alfrocheiro, and Tinta Roriz. It offers notes of red berries, floral undertones, and subtle oak. The wine is characterized by its smooth tannins and vibrant acidity, making it an excellent companion for a variety of dishes. Often praised for its exceptional quality-to-price ratio.

name: Pêra-Manca
notes: Pêra-Manca is a prestigious red wine produced by Cartuxa Winery in the Alentejo region of Portugal. The wine is known for its rich, complex flavor profile with notes of ripe black fruits, chocolate, and spices. It is full-bodied with well-integrated tannins and has the potential for long-term aging. The wine is a blend of Trincadeira and Aragonez grapes and reflects the heritage and quality of the Alentejo wine-growing region.

name: Veuve Clicquot Brut
notes: Veuve Clicquot Brut is a non-vintage champagne made from a blend of Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, and Pinot Meunier grapes. It is renowned for its full-bodied structure, lively acidity, and complex flavors of ripe fruit, brioche, and vanilla. The champagne is aged for a minimum of 30 months in Veuve Clicquot's cellars in Reims, ensuring its signature style and consistent quality. It pairs well with a variety of dishes, including seafood, mild cheeses, and light appetizers. The house of Veuve Clicquot is known for its long history and innovative production techniques, establishing its reputation as a leader in quality champagne production.

name: Caballo Loco Grand Cru Apalta
notes: Caballo Loco Grand Cru Apalta is a premium red wine from the Apalta Valley in Chile, renowned for its exceptional quality. This wine showcases a rich and complex flavor profile, often highlighting dark fruits, spices, and smooth tannins. The Apalta region is well-regarded for producing some of Chile's finest red wines, with a focus on full-bodied and well-structured profiles. The bottle has a 14.0% alcohol content.

name: Primitivo di Manduria
notes: Bastioni della Rocca produces this DOC wine known for its robust and rich character. Primitivo di Manduria wines are typically full-bodied with flavors of dark fruit, such as blackberry and plum, along with spicy notes of black pepper and clove. These wines often have a high alcohol content and a long finish. The Primitivo grape is genetically similar to Zinfandel and grows well in the warm climate of Southern Italy, particularly in the Apulia region. The wine pairs well with grilled meats, hearty pasta dishes, and mature cheeses.

name: Càndia
notes: Càndia is an experimental, organic wine with no filtration. It is a blend of Garnatxa, Sumoll, Syrah, and Trepat, aged 8 to 12 months. It offers a unique full-bodied profile with notes of red fruit and spice. Pluja acumulada is 708 l/m² with an average temperature of 14.6°C during 2020. It is bottled at 12.5% alcohol and showcases a balance of acidity and fruitiness.

name: Pequeñas Producciones
notes: Pequeñas Producciones is known for producing limited quantity wines with a focus on quality. The 2021 vintage of Malbec from Mendoza offers rich flavors typical of the varietal, including dark fruit, plum, and notes of spice. This wine benefits from the high-altitude vineyards of Mendoza, which contribute to its balance and complexity. It is best paired with red meats, grilled dishes, and strong cheeses.

name: Brumes de Gascogne
notes: Brumes de Gascogne is a wine from the Sud-Ouest France region, specifically Côtes de Gascogne, made with Merlot and Tannat grapes. This wine is part of an Indication Géographique Protégée (IGP), which signifies a quality wine from a designated geographical area. The wine is known for its balanced profile, combining the smooth fruitiness of Merlot with the structure and boldness of Tannat. It often presents flavors of dark berries, with notes of spice and a hint of smokiness. It is versatile and pairs well with a variety of foods including meats and cheeses.

name: Nicola Catena Parcela Bonarda
notes: This wine is produced by Catena Zapata, a well-respected winery in Mendoza, Argentina. The label highlights the historical significance and legacy of Nicola Catena, emphasizing its familial heritage. The Bonarda grape is cultivated using traditional practices, giving the wine a rich flavor profile characteristic of the region. It typically exhibits notes of ripe red fruits, herbs, and subtle spice, with a full-bodied and smooth texture.

name: Appassimento
notes: Produced by Bastioni Della Rocca. The term 'Appassimento' refers to the winemaking process where grapes are dried before vinification, often leading to rich and concentrated flavors. The wine is classified as IGT (Indicazione Geografica Tipica), indicating a notable quality and regional association within Italy. Typical tasting notes include ripe fruit flavors, such as cherry and plum, along with hints of chocolate or spice. Enjoys a full-bodied profile with a velvety texture.

name: Almanegra Misterio
notes: Produced by Ernesto Catena. Domaine AlmaNegra is known for its deep, rich flavors with hints of dark fruits, chocolate, and spices. The wine exhibits a sensual and seductive character, often enjoyed in celebrations and rituals. The winery emphasizes mystery and depth, akin to a concealed identity behind a mask. The wine is made to reveal its essence with each glass.

name: Milla Cala Vik
notes: Milla Cala is a well-regarded red blend produced by Viña Vik in the Millahue Valley, Chile. It typically features a rich and complex profile combining Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah, Carmenere, Merlot, and Cabernet Franc. This wine is known for its deep color and aromatic intensity, offering notes of ripe red and black fruits, spices, and a touch of oak. It often exhibits a silky texture with well-integrated tannins and a long, smooth finish.

name: Larga Historia
notes: Larga Historia is a wine made from the Garnatxa grape varietal. Further details regarding the wine's region, country, and vintage were not visible on the label. Please consult reputable wine sources for comprehensive tasting notes and additional information.

name: Panacea
notes: Producer: Alyan Wines. The wine is described to have a balanced flavor profile typical of high-quality Chilean wines. Expect notes of ripe red fruits such as cherries and plums, complemented by subtle oak and spice. The wine has a smooth finish with velvety tannins. Alyan Wines is known for producing wines that highlight the unique terroir of Chile's diverse wine regions.

name: dal 1947 Vigne Vecchie
notes: Produced by Terre di San Vincenzo. Primitivo di Manduria DOP is known for rich, full-bodied wines with flavors of ripe berries and spice. Ideal for pairing with grilled meats and hearty dishes.

name: Cartuxa Tinto Reserva
notes: Cartuxa Tinto Reserva 2018 is a red wine from the Évora region in Portugal, produced by the Fundação Eugénio de Almeida. It is a blend primarily composed of Alicante Bouschet, Aragonez, and Trincadeira grape varietals. This wine is known for its rich and complex flavors, with tasting notes that often mention ripe dark fruit, spices, and a hint of oak. It is a well-balanced wine with fine tannins and a long finish. The 2018 vintage is regarded as an excellent year due to favorable weather conditions.

name: Angelo
notes: This wine is made from Nero d'Avola grapes, originating from Sicily, Italy, and is classified as Denominazione di Origine Controllata (DOC). Known for its bold flavors and rich aromas, Nero d'Avola often exhibits notes of black cherry, prune, and spice, with a balance of acidity and tannins.

name: D.V. Catena Malbec-Malbec
notes: D.V. Catena is a renowned wine from Catena Zapata, made from Malbec grapes originating from Viñedo Angélica and Viñedo La Pirámide. It embodies the rich tradition and passion of Argentine winemaking. Expect flavors of ripe blackberries and plums, with a hint of spice and well-integrated tannins. The wine showcases a deep, rich texture and a long, elegant finish.
